scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,ai,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w ai" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:no-ai: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:ai && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
